_about: Every app event Nova can send. Each event in a line's markers must be listed here. 'does' is what the app should do on screen. tools/build_events.py builds the developers' reference sheet (EVENTS.md) from this list and the lines that use each event. 'cues' lists how a writer may phrase it in a script's [brackets]; the first is the one the preview's Events panel copies. 'scene' groups it in that panel.

line_end.does: Sent automatically when a line finishes. Use it to move to the next step.

highlight_shops.does: Highlight the shops on the home map ("See those shops?").

highlight_home.does: Highlight the home on the map with the arrow ("let's head inside your home"). It stays until the child taps the home.

highlight_sticker_book.does: Highlight the sticker book in the room.

highlight_closet.does: Highlight the closet with the arrow. It stays until the child taps the closet.

highlight_back_arrow.does: Highlight the back arrow ("Tap the back arrow, and let's go!"). It stays until the child taps it.

highlight_next_world_arrow.does: Highlight the arrow that rotates to the next world ("Tap the arrow to keep traveling through worlds").

highlight_enter.does: Highlight the Enter button on the world selection screen.

clear_highlight.does: Remove whatever is highlighted right now. Use it when a highlight should end before the line does.

nova_exit.does: Nova leaves the screen; the scene stays for the child to explore and choose.

_rules: A new highlight replaces the one before it.
Highlights clear when Nova finishes the line (line_end), unless the event says it stays until the child taps.
clear_highlight removes whatever is highlighted, for a highlight that should end mid-line.
